title: Migration map -- a host's signed statement of what becomes of its prior agent system (ADR-011)
description: HOST data. `prior` declares the BOUNDARY of the prior system: every path at or below a listed root is in the census, and nothing else is -- no path is found by resemblance. Each row answers the paths at or below its `path` with one disposition from the kit's declared succession vocabulary, carrying exactly the fields that disposition declares; the most specific row answers a path. A path no row answers is undecided, never defaulted. The map is a declaration: it moves nothing.
